raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
# Description

With #3137, C++ operator tests will run in sequential and it gets a lot faster than previously because previously they run in parallel which incurs lots of overhead for launching & cleaning up. Now, even if we enable all activations, they won't take that much time to run

|  | With all activations enabled | Only enable  GeLU |
|---|---:|---:|
| Full C++ suite | 23m 9.12s | **15m 5.80s** |
| MXFP8 test groups | 123\.82s | **54\.42s** |

(Before #3137 this takes around an hour so I'd say this is acceptable for us)

## Type of change

- [ ] Documentation change (change only to the documentation, either a fix or a new content)
- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to not work as expected)
- [x] Infra/Build change
- [ ] Code refactoring

## Changes

Please list the changes introduced in this PR:

- Enable all activations

# Checklist:

- [ ] I have read and followed the [contributing guidelines](https://github.com/NVIDIA/TransformerEngine/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.rst)
- [ ] The functionality is complete
- [ ] I have commented my code, particularly in hard-to-understand areas
- [ ] I have made corresponding changes to the documentation
- [ ] My changes generate no new warnings
- [ ] I have added tests that prove my fix is effective or that my feature works
- [ ] New and existing unit tests pass locally with my changes

Confidence Score: 5/5

**[Low risk]** Enables more activation types in C\+\+ unit tests\. The PR appears safe to merge; no outstanding finding or new actionable defect was identified.

Summary

The PR enables SiLU, ReLU, QGeLU, and SReLU in the MXFP8 C++ activation test matrices. It also extends grouped multichunk dBias/dActivation coverage to those activations. Reviews (5) · Last reviewed commit: ["also enable other activations for groupe..."](https://github.com/nvidia/transformerengine/commit/0d2b69a480749adf49346af9524e5283ee82fd2c)

Comments Outside Diff

No findings outside the diff remain.

**Outdated GeLU-only comment** The comment immediately above this list says only GeLU activation tests are supported, but these four activations are now enabled. Please update or remove the comment so it does not mislead someone changing the test matrix. Note: If this suggestion doesn't match your team's coding style, reply to this and let me know. I'll remember it for next time!
